Select: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Source: molecule_dictionary, compound_structures, compound_records, docs, activities, assays, target_dictionary, molecule_hierarchy. Join: molecule_hierarchy ON parent_molregno = parent.molregno (parent filtered by chembl_id 'CHEMBL493620'), child molecule_dictionary ON molregno = hierarchy.molregno, compound_structures ON molregno, compound_records ON molregno, docs ON doc_id, activities ON record_id, assays ON assay_id, target_dictionary ON tid. Filter: parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL493620'; assays.assay_organism = 'RAW264.7'; activities.standard_type = 'IC50'. Sort: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
